name: Exp_ADXCrossing
summary: This EA trades based on the ADXCrossing custom indicator, which signals trend direction changes when the +DI and -DI lines cross. It opens buy positions on upward crosses and sell positions on downward crosses, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings. The EA also supports closing opposite positions on signal reversal and uses a new-bar check to avoid repeated signals within the same bar.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ADXCrossing自定义指标进行交易，当+DI和-DI线交叉时发出趋势方向变化信号。在向上交叉时开多仓，向下交叉时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。EA还支持在信号反转时平掉反向持仓，并使用新K线检查避免同一根K线内重复信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ADX指标中+DI和-DI线的交叉来判断趋势方向转换。入场条件为：当UpValue（+DI上穿-DI）信号出现时开多仓，当DnValue（-DI上穿+DI）信号出现时开空仓，信号在指定SignalBar上读取。出场条件包括固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit，以及反向信号触发平仓——即出现买入信号时平卖仓，出现卖出信号时平买仓。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除浮亏后的保证金比例、扣除浮亏后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理使用MM参数控制风险比例或固定手数大小，默认0.1手。EA还包含一个额外的逻辑：当开仓和平仓都启用但没有反向平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找更早的反向信号来决定是否平仓，这是一个增强的平仓检测机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of the +DI and -DI lines within the ADX indicator to identify trend direction changes. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when UpValue (+DI crossing above -DI) signal appears, and open a sell position when DnValue (-DI crossing above +DI) signal appears, read from the specified SignalBar. Exit conditions include fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels, as well as reverse signal triggered closes — a buy signal closes sell positions and a sell signal closes buy positions. Position sizing supports five modes via the MMMode parameter: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk percentage or fixed lot size, defaulting to 0.1 lots. The EA also includes an enhanced logic: when both open and close permissions are enabled but no reverse close signal is detected on the current bar, it scans forward through historical bars to find an earlier reverse signal, serving as an extended close detection mechanism.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制交易手数或风险比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size or risk ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/扣除浮亏保证金/扣除浮亏余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: MM mode: Free margin/Balance/Free margin minus floating/Floating-adjusted balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入信号平卖仓
parameters.description_en: Allow buy signal to close sell positions

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出信号平买仓
parameters.description_en: Allow sell signal to close buy positions

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前Bar，1=已收盘Bar）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典的ADX交叉信号，趋势判断有理论支撑
提供五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易风格和风险偏好
支持独立控制开仓和平仓方向，可灵活配置为只开不平和只平不开
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
包含向前回溯检测反向信号的增强平仓逻辑，减少遗漏平仓机会
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the classic ADX crossover signal with solid theoretical support for trend identification
Five money management modes providing flexibility for different trading styles and risk preferences
Independent control over open and close directions, allowing flexible configuration such as open-only or close-only modes
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Enhanced forward-scanning reverse signal detection for closes, reducing missed exit opportunities
cons: ADX周期设为50较长，信号滞后明显，可能在趋势初期错过大量行情
止损1000点和止盈2000点偏大，未考虑品种的ATR动态调整，固定值可能不适应所有市场
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在流动性差或点差大的时段可能产生不利成交
自定义指标ADXCrossing未内嵌，依赖外部文件，部署时容易缺失导致EA无法运行
历史K线回溯平仓逻辑没有上限限制，在极端情况下可能遍历大量历史数据影响性能
cons_en: ADX period of 50 is relatively long, causing significant signal lag that may miss substantial early trend movement
StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are large fixed values without ATR-based dynamic adjustment, potentially unsuitable for all market conditions
No spread filter or trading session filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity or high-spread periods
The custom ADXCrossing indicator is not embedded, relying on an external file that can be missing during deployment, causing the EA to fail initialization
The historical bar scanning close logic has no upper bound limit, potentially iterating through large amounts of historical data and impacting performance in extreme cases
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，使风控参数能自动适应不同品种和波动环境
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段开仓
为历史K线回溯平仓逻辑添加最大回溯Bar数限制，防止性能问题
将ADXCrossing指标逻辑内嵌到EA中，消除外部依赖，提高部署可靠性
improvements_en: Replace fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit with ATR-based dynamic calculation so risk parameters auto-adapt to different instruments and volatility environments
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread and low-liquidity periods
Add a maximum lookback bar limit to the historical bar scanning close logic to prevent performance issues
Embed the ADXCrossing indicator logic directly into the EA to eliminate external dependency and improve deployment reliability

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未根据市场波动率动态调整，在不同波动环境下可能导致过度风险暴露或止损失效
缺少点差过滤，高点差市场可能导致入场滑点过大从而显著影响盈亏比
外部指标依赖可能导致EA在初始化时失败，若用户未正确部署指标文件则无法交易
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit not dynamically adjusted for market volatility, potentially causing excessive risk exposure or ineffective stops in different volatility environments
No spread filter means high-spread markets may cause excessive entry slippage, significantly impacting risk-reward ratio
External indicator dependency may cause EA initialization failure if users do not correctly deploy the indicator file
